mapper.sql: p.id, p.tenant_id, p.create_user_id, p.create_time, p.update_user_id, p.update_time, p.deleted_at, p.version, p.resource_id, p.operation, p.request_id, p.request_sha256, p.previous_version_id, p.target_version_id, p.source_version_id, p.result_revision, p.target_created
FROM ddc_ai_publication p JOIN ddc_ai_resource r ON r.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND r.id = p.resource_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT , tv.version_no AS target_version_no FROM ddc_ai_publication p JOIN ddc_ai_version tv ON tv.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND tv.resource_id = p.resource_id AND tv.id = p.target_version_id AND tv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.request_id = #{requestId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
